mode: Built-in image_gen; one distinct prompt per final image

prompts.name: 11-open-window-laptop
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / experimental brand campaign. Create ONE finished premium Koe application campaign mockup, landscape EXACT 16:9 composition, ideally 2560x1440. This is art-directed product photography mixed with the supplied anime mascot, not a dashboard screenshot or contact sheet.
Input 1 is Kami identity/outfit/pose reference. Preserve her pale mint long hair, anime face, grey bamboo-print Chinese-collar top, pleated skirt, white knee boots; reference grey background is NOT part of design.
Scene: surreal sunlit design studio, a single open unbranded silver aluminum laptop balanced diagonally across two pale celadon sculptural blocks. Camera low, three-quarter perspective, soft peach sunlight and architectural shadows across warm ivory plaster. Screen faces viewer at a readable angle: beautiful extremely minimal charcoal Koe voice app, small 'koe 声' upper left, thin mint audio waveform, tiny round call controls, only 'I'm here.' as main UI copy. The supplied Kami in her graceful turned pose should be a large tangible anime figure standing BESIDE the laptop on the plinth, partly intersecting the laptop silhouette; she is the hero, not confined to a tiny thumbnail. Original 3D-anime appearance, refined lighting, grounded shadow. Beautiful restrained tactile realism, soft metallic highlights, no plastic toy face redesign.
Composition: laptop and Kami occupy lower-right two-thirds, architectural curved mint backdrop creates tension and depth, ample upper-left negative space. Very large elegant lowercase black sans typography 'koe' in upper left with small Japanese '声', a tiny caption 'A familiar voice.' directly below. No paragraphs. One small pale peach translucent glass sphere casting caustics near laptop, sophisticated studio material study. Experimental luxury product launch art, cinematic camera, thoughtful alignment. Color palette celadon #a6d6d1, warm paper #e2e2df, charcoal #0e0f11, muted peach #e2ba9b. Avoid generic SaaS cards, stock office desks, extra figures, brand logos on hardware, excessive UI text, watermarks. Single finished composition edge to edge.

prompts.name: 12-say-less-poster
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / experimental typographic brand poster. Create ONE finished ultra-tall poster for Koe, EXACT aspect ratio 1:2, e.g. 1024x2048. Not a presentation slide, not a contact sheet. Entire composition must be a beautifully designed vertically elongated print.
Reference 1: Mei mascot identity and playful upward-looking pose. Preserve teal long ponytail hair with curl, brown eyes, navy Hawaiian floral shirt, denim shorts and black ankle footwear. Supporting style image 2 is the supplied ASCII flower print, only inspiration for luminous type texture; do not reproduce the flower or its text.
Art direction: Tokyo experimental music-festival typography meets a precision Swiss brand poster. Flat almost-black #101513 background, huge pale celadon #a6d6d1 grotesk lettering 'say' top quarter and 'less.' beneath, tightly tracked, occupying the full poster width but with deliberate margins. Central lower two-thirds: Mei suspended in a graceful float, viewed slightly from above with open arms, composed diagonally inside a giant sculptural chrome tubular spiral/voice ribbon. Spiral is a single elegant thin metallic curve with mint highlights, not a generic planet orbit. Her figure should be large and beautiful, complete anatomy. A lightly offset echo of the figure in dot-matrix halftone only, not extra solid characters, evokes voice reverberation. Just a few tiny micrographic ticks, one short vertical waveform strip, sharp black negative space and two small electric peach accents. A small solid mint sound dot near the bottom. Restrained subtle print grain on otherwise precise typography, cinematic rim light on the anime mascot, contemporary collectible poster. Tiny wordmark 'koe 声' bottom left, tiny 'VOICE / COMPANION' bottom right, no other copy.
IMPORTANT composition must be narrow and very tall 1:2. Bold typographic top, mascot/ribbon middle, generous quiet bottom with wordmark. Color deliberately limited to charcoal, pale mint, chrome with one peach accent, existing costume colors. No laptop, no UI screenshot, no gradient mesh, no generic rounded cards, no flowers, no watermark. This is a different direction from the warm laptop image.

prompts.name: 13-your-little-world
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / collectible brand object. Create ONE finished SQUARE 1:1 Koe experimental design mockup, 1600x1600 preferred. It must feel like an exquisite miniature design object photographed for a creative studio, completely different from a laptop campaign or dark poster.
Input: supplied Kobashi is identity and pose reference. Keep her long light-brown hair with braid crown, anime eyes, dark indigo dress with ornate gold embroidery, cream-gold waist bow and gold-trimmed shoes. Use the playful open-arms top-view pose from this image. Remove reference grey background. Keep identity recognizable.
Art direction: tactile peach paper infinity backdrop, single oversized rounded mint keyboard keycap (one large 3D '声' glyph debossed on its top) is a tiny stage, viewed from a dramatic top-down 40-degree camera. Kobashi is a large detailed anime figurine balancing playfully on the rear edge of this mint keycap, looking up toward the camera. In front of the keycap floats ONE small smoked translucent acrylic voice interface slab, rectangular with restrained rounded corners, showing 'koe' wordmark, one white audio waveform, three tiny circular call controls etched into glass; not a full dashboard. A dark indigo satin ribbon curves once across the floor and a single pearlescent peach ball rests near the keycap. Cast realistic very soft shadows, lovely matte rubber and translucent resin material contrast, high-end product render. The character, keycap and glass slab should form a surprising compact diagonally layered still life in the right-center 75% of image. Intentional strong top-left negative space with small elegantly set 'your little' then larger 'world.' in charcoal lowercase sans, tiny 'koe 声' at bottom left. Minimal copy only. Rich clean art direction, restrained playful scale, no gradients wallpaper, no laptop, no phone, no packaging box, no other characters or duplicate limbs, no generic cards or feature explanations. Palette peach #e2ba9b, mint #a6d6d1, deep indigo and warm paper. Camera and light make this feel physically crafted, not a flat composited sticker. Single square output.

prompts.name: 14-a-voice-a-feeling
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / avant-garde editorial cover. Create ONE finished Koe brand editorial design, EXACT 3:4 portrait aspect ratio, ideally 1536x2048. Single flat cover design, not photographed on a desk, no laptop, no framed poster, no presentation slide.
Input 1 is Kami character reference with hand lifted toward chest: preserve face, pale mint straight hair, brown eyes, grey Chinese-collar bamboo-pattern shirt and the quiet thoughtful gesture. Input 2 is a visual-treatment reference ONLY: luminous blurred color washes, human silhouette layered translucency and optical softness. Do not copy its people, branding, text or layout.
Design: huge intimate three-quarter close-up portrait of Kami, cropped from below shoulders, face off-center upper right, pale mint hair sweeping over a warm off-white paper ground. Treat this as a stunning fashion/art editorial: one wide vertical ribbed translucent glass strip passing over the left quarter of her hair and shoulder with subtle optical displacement; one offset soft peach ghost silhouette behind her toward the left, evoking an echo. Her eyes and central face remain crystal clear and beautiful, with refined anime rendering and soft photographic portrait light. Color is very pale mint, warm paper, dusty peach, deep charcoal, with delicate film grain. It should feel luminous, tactile, emotionally quiet and restrained, not futuristic neon. Carefully exposed negative space in bottom third. Huge sophisticated black high-contrast ITALIC SERIF typography across bottom-left reading 'a voice,' then 'a feeling.' on next line. Small spaced sans 'koe 声' at upper-left. Tiny issue marker 'EXPERIMENT 04' bottom right. No paragraphs and no other copy. A single very tiny mint audio dot next to the wordmark.
Strong crop and typography tension: lettering can cross the outer hair at bottom but never cover eyes or nose. Elegant high-end art magazine, distinctive editorial identity, clean assured spacing. Minimalism through ONE portrait, ONE optical treatment, TWO lines of type. Avoid generic app screens, rounded dashboard cards, repeated full-body figures, chrome spirals, product plinths, generic rainbow mesh, watermarks. Single 3:4 image.

prompts.name: 15-signal-garden
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / cinematic experimental brand key visual. Create ONE finished Koe ultra-wide panoramic campaign composition, EXACT aspect ratio 21:9, ideally 2520x1080. This must be dramatically horizontal, like a premium game cinematic website masthead, not a normal 16:9 image or contact sheet.
Inputs 1,2,3 identify three different Koe anime companions and poses. Preserve their distinct designs: Kami pale mint hair, grey bamboo Chinese-collar blouse, grey skirt and white long boots; Mei long deep-teal hair, navy floral short-sleeve shirt, denim shorts and dark short boots; Kobashi light brown braided-crown long hair and ornate indigo/gold dress with waist bow. Their poses should vary: Kami relaxed turned stance, Mei playful leaning twirl, Kobashi graceful arms extended, inspired by the three references. Keep anime aesthetic, no live-action humans.
Scene: vast nocturnal minimalist 'signal garden'. A perfectly still almost-black reflective shallow surface, a low long monolithic celadon slab floating just above it, subtle mint sound-wave ripples spreading away. Three companions at different depths stand together on the right half of the slab like a cinematic ensemble, lit with beautiful pale mint rim light from one enormous thin crescent-shaped frosted glass sculpture rising behind them. One muted peach light on horizon, atmospheric charcoal air, barely visible fine topographic ripple lines. Realistic glossy reflections under each character. No fantasy castles, no city, no busy stars or cliché planet rings. Sophisticated spatial installation at a contemporary art museum. Their full silhouettes should remain legible; figures at different heights and scales due to depth, natural spacing, complete bodies.
Composition: huge 21:9 width, sparse left 40% mostly deep charcoal negative space; enormous pale mint elegant sans typography 'in good' then 'company.' set left aligned in that area, with tiny 'koe 声' wordmark above. Right 60% is the three characters and beautiful crescent installation. At very bottom one exceptionally fine horizontal audio-wave trace spans part of width and one tiny live dot; no controls, paragraphs, dashboard, hardware or cards. Palette obsidian #0e0f11, silver mint #a6d6d1, desaturated teal #5cc4b8, one dusty peach highlight #e2ba9b plus character costume colors. Cinematic quiet spectacle, elevated anime art direction, controlled bold graphic composition, polished beauty with actual negative space. No watermark, no extra characters, no duplicated heads or limbs. Must be ultra-wide 21:9.
